title: Micro adjacency coverage gist
content:
Purpose: quick, lightweight matrix for ad-hoc adjacent-owner coverage and surge contacts. Use this when we need to stitch a short-term owner to pick up a one-off runtime/ops spike. Not an authoritative roster — ephemeral and meant for rapid handoff.

Context: Several recent weekend surges (ingest pipeline lag + model evict storm) highlighted gaps in adjacent ownership for: dedicated routing, console alerting, and SE customer handoff. This sheet captures owners we can ping, an estimated time-to-fix, and blockers/notes so a single on-call or SE can triage faster.

Table (CSV):
Item,Owner,Team,Priority,Est_hours,Est_cost_usd,Blocker,Status,Next_step,Notes
Dedicated routing fallback check,Marcus Chen,eng-platform,High,6,960,missing playbook,in_progress,run canary failover script,Need quick doc link + test account
Console alert-runbook update,Lena Ortiz,engineering-observability,High,12,1920,no test dashboard,due,assign doc owner,keep runbook minimal (steps 1-4)
SE customer-facing escalation path,Omar Noureldin,solutions-eng,Medium,4,640,unclear SLA owners,blocked,confirm escalation list,pull last 3 support tickets for reference
KV-cache eviction triage,Priya Rao,serving-runtime,High,3,480,insufficient traces,in_progress,add trace hook + short run,may need kernel dump from infra
Burst-capacity reservation check,Diego Martinez,platform-engineering,Medium,8,1280,quota unclear,open,confirm region quotas,estimate cost for 24h hold
Billing lasso for surge credits,Sarah Kim,finance-and-legal,Low,2,320,policy review required,open,seek temporary credit approval,note: prioritize enterprise accounts
Region failover smoke test,Rachel Nguyen,site-reliability-engineering,Medium,5,800,staging creds outdated,planned,update creds and run smoke,document flakiness seen in ap-southeast-1
Customer-ops handoff checklist,Noah Patel,customer-success,Low,3,480,missing contact for acct,open,create 1-pager for SE handoff,include account-specific runbook

Quick totals:
Total_est_hours: 43
Total_est_cost_usd: 6880

Prioritization notes:
- 'High' items are those that directly affect live request surface or SLA (routing, cache eviction, alerting).
- Medium items reduce time-to-recover and increase confidence across regions.
- Low items are administrative but help customer experience post-incident.

Immediate asks (today):
- Marcus: run the dedicated routing canary by 18:00 PST and post results in #runtime-ops (tag: @oncall).
- Lena: pick a minimal doc owner — aim for one page that says: how to detect, first three mitigation steps, and who to call.
- Diego: confirm quotas for US-west-2 and ap-southeast-1 by EOD. If >2h effort, request temporary capacity to avoid cascading fallbacks.

Unresolved questions / to validate:
- Do we have an up-to-date playbook for automatic fallback from dedicated -> hosted models? (I think partial; need a clear owner.)
- Is there a quick cost bucket we can charge surge-reserved capacity to for trial customers? (Finance: Sarah to confirm.)
- Can SRE provide a one-off audit of staging creds used for region tests? (Rachel owning)

Notes to self / rough timeline:
- If critical item triggered: 0-30m initial triage, 30-90m shallow fixes (routing rollback/canary), 2-6h deep mitigation (capacity reservation, SE handoff).
- This doc should be copied into the incident channel on first triage and pinned for the incident timeline.

References / quick links:
- Playbook draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/adjacency-catalog
- Related tickets: ENG-4823, PROD-739 (customer-replay), SE-1142
- Slack thread: #runtime-ops (thread ts:1658321234.004200)

Versioning / provenance:
- Created by Aisha Patel on 2026-11-02 as an ad-hoc stitch for weekend coverage. Will iterate after first real-world use and fold good actions into the adjacency-catalog confluence page.

Tagging guidance:
- Use tags: team name + "ad-hoc" when creating follow-ups (ex: eng-platform-ad-hoc).

End.
